# CSOAI — Council for the Safety of AI
> The ISO for AI Safety. AI Act / NIST RMF / ISO 42001 / TC260 compliance, certification, and a registry of 293+ governance MCP servers — all on one platform.

## What CSOAI provides
- Compliance: EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001, TC260 — crosswalked across frameworks
- Certification: CEASAI (Certified Expert in AI Safety), Watchdog certs — Ed25519-signed
- 293+ MCP servers (Model Context Protocol) for AI governance, compliance, and agent infrastructure
- 52-Article Charter; 33-agent Byzantine council; PDCA framework

## Key pages
- Home: https://csoai.org/
- MCP Registry (293+ servers): https://csoai.org/mcp
- Pricing: https://csoai.org/pricing
- Certification: https://csoai.org/certification
- Charter (52 articles): https://csoai.org/charter
- Crosswalks: https://csoai.org/crosswalks
- Standards: https://csoai.org/standards
- API docs: https://csoai.org/api-docs
